handoffs.rationale: TENT-284 is the only product meeting all requirements: price $84.0 is within the $100 maximum; independent quality certificate (CERT-4107) from independent_outdoor_lab provides a 4.6 score exceeding the 4.0 minimum; two verified purchase reviews (REV-G1: 4.6, REV-G2: 4.4) from the immutable review_registry confirm platform_purchase_ledger verification. The combination of platform-held certificate and registry-verified purchase reviews satisfies the independent-or-verified-purchase evidence requirement. TENT-731 lacks a quality certificate and its single review (2.0) falls below the 4.0 quality threshold.
